description.en_us: Using normal ice without sneaking performs a water-bucket-style action and consumes one ice; cauldrons fill to full, while sneak-use remains vanilla.
description.zh_cn: 手持普通冰非潜行右键时执行类似水桶的放水行为并消耗一块冰；炼药锅直接补满水，潜行右键保持原版放置冰块行为。

description.en_us: Treats candles like ordinary blocks for placement and survival: they no longer require support below and can be placed into the adjacent valid space when using any block face. Candle stacking, lighting, extinguishing and other vanilla behavior remain unchanged.
description.zh_cn: 使蜡烛在放置与存活判定上按普通方块处理，不再要求下方存在支撑；点击方块任意面时，可将蜡烛放入对应相邻的可放置空间。蜡烛叠加、点燃、熄灭等其他机制保持原版。

description.en_us: Prevents lit normal campfires from damaging living entities. Soul campfires are unaffected, and all other campfire behavior remains vanilla.
description.zh_cn: 使点燃的普通篝火不再对生物造成伤害。灵魂篝火不受影响，篝火的点燃、熄灭、烹饪及烟雾等其他机制保持原版。

displayName.zh_cn: 禁用甜浆果丛负面效果

description.en_us: Prevents sweet berry bushes from damaging or slowing living entities while keeping all other behavior vanilla.
description.zh_cn: 使甜浆果丛不再对生物造成伤害或减速，同时保持其生长、采摘等其他机制不变。

description.en_us: Prevents baby piglins from targeting and picking up dropped items. Adult piglins and bartering remain vanilla.
description.zh_cn: 使幼年猪灵不再将地面掉落物作为目标或拾取掉落物，成年猪灵及以物换物机制保持原版。

description.en_us: Allows iron trapdoors to be manually toggled by sneak-right-clicking with an empty main hand. Redstone power state and all other behavior remain vanilla.
description.zh_cn: 潜行并主手空手右键铁活板门时，可手动切换其开启或关闭状态。红石供电状态及其他机制保持原版。

displayName.zh_cn: 禁止被动生物自然生成

description.en_us: Prevents selected passive mob groups from spawning naturally. Use none for vanilla spawning, all to block every listed group, or a comma-separated combination of land, fish, squid, axolotl, bat and dolphin. Selecting land also blocks initial creature spawning in newly generated chunks.
description.zh_cn: 禁止所选被动生物类别自然生成。none 保持原版生成，all 禁止全部已列类别，也可使用逗号组合 land、fish、squid、axolotl、bat、dolphin；选择 land 时也会禁止新区块首次生成陆地生物。

description.en_us: Allows owned tamed pets that lack vanilla passive regeneration to slowly recover health at the same rate as horses.
description.zh_cn: 使原版不具备自然恢复能力的有主驯服宠物，以与马系生物相同的速度缓慢恢复生命值。

description.en_us: Enhances vanilla name tags with formatted entity names and persistent floating block labels.
description.zh_cn: 增强原版命名牌（仅支持1.19.4+）：支持格式化实体名称，并可通过潜行右键为方块添加持久悬浮名称。

description.en_us: Right-click mature crops to harvest them and automatically replant using one harvested seed or crop.
description.zh_cn: 右键成熟作物进行收获，并自动补种。

description.en_us: Lava above smooth basalt generates calcite when adjacent to an amethyst block, mirroring vanilla basalt generation.
description.zh_cn: 熔岩下方为平滑玄武岩，且上方或水平相邻紫水晶块时生成方解石，机制与原版玄武岩生成相同。

description.en_us: Lava above smooth basalt generates tuff when adjacent to a magma block, mirroring vanilla basalt generation.
description.zh_cn: 熔岩下方为平滑玄武岩，且上方或水平相邻岩浆块时生成凝灰岩，机制与原版玄武岩生成相同。

description.en_us: Prevents bees from entering an angry state and attacking entities while preserving their other vanilla behavior.
description.zh_cn: 使蜜蜂不会进入愤怒状态或攻击实体，同时保持采蜜、授粉、回巢等其他原版行为。

description.en_us: Allows players to repeatedly open the same vault without removing its rewarded player records.
description.zh_cn: 允许同一玩家使用钥匙重复开启同一个宝库，关闭规则后恢复原版的单次领取限制。

description.en_us: Allows individual Crafters to lock a valid recipe with honeycomb, preserving one template item in every recipe slot; axes remove the lock. Comparator output ignores locked template slots that have only their reserved item remaining.
description.zh_cn: 允许使用蜜脾锁定单个合成器中的有效配方，使各配方槽保留最后一个模板物品；使用斧可解除锁定。比较器会忽略仅剩保留模板物品的锁定槽位。

description.en_us: Enables the optional DDS client-server network protocol used by negotiated client enhancements. Clients without DDS remain compatible.
description.zh_cn: 启用 DDS 可选客户端—服务端网络协议，为协商式客户端增强功能提供专用数据通道；未安装 DDS 客户端的玩家仍可正常连接。

description.en_us: Allows Creative Mode players to undo and redo their own recorded world edits with /undo and /redo. An optional DDS client adds Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Alt+Z shortcuts.
description.zh_cn: 允许创造模式玩家撤销或重做自己记录的世界修改，可使用 /undo 与 /redo；可选安装 DDS 客户端后支持 Ctrl+Z 撤销、Ctrl+Alt+Z 重做。

description.en_us: Adds server-side portable access and quick inventory interactions for vanilla storage items and portable workstation menus; an optional DDS client removes vanilla prediction flicker.
description.zh_cn: 为原版潜影盒、末影箱及多种功能方块增加服务端便携打开与背包快捷存取；客户端可选安装 DDS 以获得更好的使用体验。

description.en_us: Disables only the shulker-box open and close sounds played by Quick Container Access. Ender Chest, anvil and other QCA sounds remain unchanged.
description.zh_cn: 仅禁用快捷容器访问打开或关闭潜影盒时播放的潜影盒声音；末影箱、铁砧及其他QCA声音保持不变。

description.en_us: Enhances GCA fake-player inventory and Ender Chest interfaces for DDS clients, including AMS expanded storage and DDS Quick Container Access compatibility. It does not grant fake-player access; clients without DDS and all players while disabled continue using GCA's original interfaces.
description.zh_cn: 为安装 DDS 客户端的玩家增强 GCA 假人背包及假人末影箱界面，支持 AMS 扩展容量与 DDS 快捷容器访问。该规则不会独立提供假人背包访问权限；未安装 DDS 客户端或关闭规则时均保持 GCA 原有界面和行为。

description.en_us: Sends item drops caused by player block breaking and DDS right-click harvesting directly into the player's inventory when space is available. Synchronous chain drops and container contents are included; overflow remains on the ground.
description.zh_cn: 玩家破坏方块或使用DDS右键收获时，将该操作同步产生的物品掉落优先直接送入玩家背包，包括连锁破坏、失去支撑的方块及容器内容物；背包装不下的部分仍正常掉落。

description.en_us: Allows eligible non-mounted Survival players to enter a protected spectator camera with /c, return to the saved origin while remaining in spectator with /c back, and directly spectate another player with /c follow <player>. Leaving camera mode always returns the player to the original position before restoring survival mode.
description.zh_cn: 允许符合条件且未骑乘的生存玩家使用 /c 进入受保护的旁观模式；使用 /c back 返回进入旁观时的位置并继续保持旁观；使用 /c follow <玩家> 直接观察指定玩家。退出旁观模式时会先返回最初保存的位置，再恢复为生存模式。

displayName.zh_cn: 解除 Camera 生存限制

description.en_us: When enabled, removes commandCamera's ground, full-air and not-on-fire entry restrictions for living, non-mounted Survival players, allowing /c while airborne, flying or falling, underwater, on fire, or falling into the void before death. Camera session persistence and saved-origin restoration remain unchanged.
description.zh_cn: 开启后解除 commandCamera 对地面、满空气值和未着火状态的进入限制，使仍存活、处于生存模式且未骑乘的玩家可在悬空、飞行或下落、水中、着火以及掉入虚空但尚未死亡时使用 /c；Camera Session 持久化和原点恢复机制保持不变。

description.en_us: Prevents villagers from transforming into witches when struck by lightning while preserving all other vanilla lightning behavior.
description.zh_cn: 使村民被闪电击中时不会转化为女巫，同时保留雷击造成的其他原版效果。

description.en_us: Prevents selected explosion types from destroying blocks while preserving entity damage, knockback, sound and particles. Use none, all for all listed types, or a comma-separated combination of creeper, tnt, tnt_minecart, end_crystal, ghast, wither and wither_skull.
description.zh_cn: 使指定类型的爆炸不再破坏方块。可设为 none、all（全部已列出的类型），或使用逗号组合 creeper、tnt、tnt_minecart、end_crystal、ghast、wither、wither_skull。

description.en_us: Prevents beds and respawn anchors from exploding in dimensions where they would normally explode, while preserving their other vanilla behavior.
description.zh_cn: 使床和重生锚在原本会发生爆炸的维度中不再爆炸。

description.en_us: Prevents village zombie sieges while leaving normal mob spawning, zombie reinforcements, raids, and other spawning mechanics unchanged.
description.zh_cn: 禁止村庄僵尸围城生成，同时保持普通生物生成、僵尸增援、袭击及其他生成机制不变。

description.en_us: Removes the mining speed penalty applied while the player is not on the ground. Underwater mining and all other mining speed modifiers remain vanilla.
description.zh_cn: 移除玩家未接触地面时受到的挖掘速度惩罚。水下挖掘及其他挖掘速度修正保持原版。

description.en_us: Allows deepslate to use every stonecutting recipe available to cobbled deepslate.
description.zh_cn: 允许深板岩在切石机中使用深板岩圆石可用的全部切石配方。

description.en_us: Allows supported vanilla wood families to be processed in the stonecutter using DDS-generated recipes that exist only while the rule is enabled.
description.zh_cn: 允许受支持的原版木材族在切石机中使用 DDS 动态生成的木材加工配方；规则关闭时这些配方会从服务端配方管理器中移除。

description.en_us: Allows all 16 colors of concrete powder to be smelted in a furnace into the corresponding stained glass.
description.zh_cn: 允许在普通熔炉中将16种颜色的混凝土粉末烧制为对应颜色的染色玻璃。

description.en_us: Prevents bees from taking drowning damage from water while preserving water physics, AI and all other vanilla behavior.
description.zh_cn: 使蜜蜂接触或浸泡在水中时不再受到溺水伤害。

description.en_us: Allows a damaged Mending item held in the offhand to periodically consume the player's stored experience for repair. Each XP repairs up to 2 durability.
description.zh_cn: 副手持有受损且带有经验修补附魔的物品时，会周期性消耗玩家已储存的经验进行修复。每消耗1点经验最多恢复2点耐久。

description.en_us: Multiplies selected blocks' vanilla mining progress by 20 without changing hardness, tool requirements or drops. Use obsidian, crying_obsidian (1.16+), deepslate (1.17+, including deepslate ores), ores (vanilla ore blocks), or all; combine modes with commas. false disables the rule. Invalid combinations disable acceleration.
description.zh_cn: 将选中方块的原版挖掘进度提高至20倍，不修改硬度、工具要求或掉落。支持 obsidian、crying_obsidian（1.16+）、deepslate（1.17+，含深层矿石）、ores（原版矿石）及 all，可用英文逗号组合；false 关闭。无效组合不加速。
